paragraphs: TechTarget, Inc. ("Informa TechTarget", the "Company", "we", "us" or "our") is a leading business-to-business ("B2B") growth accelerator, informing and influencing technology buyers and sellers globally.

Today, we sit at the intersection of tech and B2B marketing in an area estimated to be worth $20 billion annually with approximately 45,000 potential customers. We compete in the Intelligence & Advisory, Brand & Content, and Demand & Intent markets.

We have powerful scale in permissioned B2B first-party data and a unique end-to-end portfolio of data-driven solutions that services the full B2B product lifecycle, from R&D to return on investment ("ROI"): from strategy, messaging and content development to in-market activation via brand, demand generation, purchase intent data and sales enablement. Increasingly, we are leveraging AI to bolster our differentiation to both technology buyers and sellers, including growing audience referrals from AI search channels.

For technology buyers and business professionals, which we refer to as audiences, our strategy calls for us to deliver trusted, independent research, primary data, analysis and high-quality editorial content that uniquely informs and has the potential to influence technology buyers. We believe we are well positioned to deliver on this strategy.

For technology sellers, which we refer to as clients, our strategy is to offer expert-led, data-driven, digitally enabled products that help those clients to identify and influence technology buyers through the full product journey, and based on this value proposition, for us to be a strategic partner to many of the technology industry's largest and most successful, fastest and most innovative players, shortening those clients' time to market and, critically, to revenue. We have the ambition to become a leading B2B growth accelerator.
We focus on four core growth drivers when executing on these strategies:

1. Enterprise IT market acceleration: The enterprise IT market is forecast to grow at a 7.1% compounded annual growth rate in the United States over the next five years, driven by easing inflation, improving gross domestic product trends and accelerated growth in research and development investment and innovation, underpinned by the rapid expansion of AI applications.

2. International expansion: We estimate that technology sellers based outside the United States represent approximately 40% of the global market opportunity for the products we offer. We believe we are well positioned to exploit that market opportunity and intend to do so. Through our Specialist Tech Research business and a portfolio of localized specialist content websites, we have a presence in the United Kingdom, India, Spain, France, China, Australia, Singapore, Japan and other countries, with the Middle East region becoming an increasingly relevant opportunity.

3. Growth in Industry Technology Markets: We plan to expand our product set into adjacent, tech-driven growth markets, including for example AutoTech, GameTech, HealthTech and FinTech, partially by leveraging our data sharing agreement (the "Data Sharing Agreement") with Informa, to extensive B2B datasets covering these growth markets.

4. New product and platform development: We intend to exploit our expanded scale, reach and talent to accelerate platform enhancements and new product launches to deliver richer data-driven insights and deeper market access. The new products we intend to develop include audience focused services, such as new content websites, newsletters, and research, which are designed to expand and enrich B2B audiences, and go-to-market products and services intended to accelerate client time to market and to revenue, including Intelligence & Advisory, Brand & Content and Intent & Demand. Towards the end of 2025, we launched Informa TechTarget Portal a unified platform for insights and activation that integrates our entire solution portfolio to drive more effective customer sales and marketing outreach. The new platform is intended to significantly enhance and succeed the Priority Engine predecessor.

In addition to pursuing these organic growth opportunities, we believe we are positioned to expand our businesses and market presence by opportunistically acquiring complementary businesses that add additional data, audiences, content and go-to-market and/or new capabilities that further differentiate our product offerings.

Informa TechTarget offers certain of its products to customers on a subscription basis, including annual contracts paid in advance (attracting strong cash characteristics) and other contracts that are subject to the customers' right of termination.
We expect to grow our subscription and long-term contract revenues, allowing us to work more closely with customers over a longer time period and provide a larger base of recurring revenue.

We sit at the intersection of tech and B2B marketing, each dynamic and innovative markets in their own right, and each with compelling structural growth drivers. We estimate that the participants in these interconnected markets collectively generate revenues from these markets of approximately $20 billion per year. We believe the strength and growth potential of these markets represents a robust and growing market opportunity for us.

headings: The integration of our legacy businesses presents challenges that may prevent us from realizing all the anticipated benefits of the Transactions.
Informa could engage in business and other activities that compete with us.
Failure to successfully implement and operate under the Data Sharing Agreement between us and Informa could impact the potential benefits of the Transactions.
The areas in which we compete are rapidly evolving, which makes it difficult to forecast demand for our products and services.

Because most of our customers are in the enterprise technology industry, our revenues are subject to characteristics of the enterprise technology industry that can affect advertising spending by B2B technology companies.
Our future growth depends in large part on continued increases in sales of data-driven products and services.
The majority of our revenues are primarily derived from short-term contracts that may not be renewed.
Because we recognize subscription revenue over the subscription term, downturns or upturns in new sales, renewals and upgrades will not be immediately reflected within our results of operations.

If we are unable to deliver content and services that attract and retain a critical mass of members and users, our ability to attract customers may be affected, which could in turn have an adverse effect on our revenues.
There are a number of risks associated with our international operations, as well as the expansion of those operations, which could adversely affect our business.

Competition for customers' marketing and advertising spending is intense, and we may not compete successfully, which could result in a material reduction in our market share, the number of our customers and our revenues.

We may experience competition from other companies with technologies and data to deliver B2B market insight and market access, and competing products and services could provide greater appeal to customers.
We rely on key counterparties to support our business and help deliver certain of our products, including integration with third-party applications and systems that we do not control.
We may not innovate at a successful pace, which could harm our operating results.
We may be unable to continue to build awareness of our brands, which could negatively impact our business and cause our revenues to decline.
If we do not retain our key personnel, our ability to execute our business strategy will be adversely affected.
We may have limited protection of our intellectual property rights which others could infringe.

Claims from third parties based on the content created by us and third parties on our websites could result in costly litigation, payment of damages or the need to revise the way we conduct our business.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves substantial risks. You should carefully consider the following factors, together with all of the other information included in this Annual Report, including under the heading "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and the consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report before investing in our common stock. Any of the risk factors we describe below could adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. The market price of our common stock could decline if one or more of these risks or uncertainties develop into actual events, causing you to lose all or part of your investment. We cannot assure you that any of the events discussed below will not occur. Please also see "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" in this Annual Report for more information.

Our management team will continue to devote attention and resources to integrating the business practices and operations, which operated as independent businesses prior to the business combination. Potential difficulties we may encounter in the integration process include the following:

• the difficulty in successfully integrating, or the inability to successfully integrate, our businesses, including their respective operations, technologies, products and services, and customer contracts, in a manner that permits us to achieve the cost savings and revenue synergies anticipated to result from the combination, which could result in the anticipated benefits of the combination not being realized partly or wholly in the time frame currently anticipated or at all;

• lost sales and customers as a result of certain customers of any of the businesses deciding not to do business with us, or deciding to decrease the amount of business they do with us in order to reduce their reliance on a single company;
• the necessity of coordinating geographically separated organizations, systems and facilities;
• potential unknown liabilities and unforeseen increased expenses, delays or regulatory conditions associated with the combination;

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions. Our actual results could differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those discussed below and elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, particularly under the heading "Risk Factors." Please refer to our "Forward-Looking Statements" section on page 3 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
Informa TechTarget helps technology companies accelerate growth through first party B2B data, market insight and market access.

Following a period of expansion, the specialist technology research business of Informa TechTarget is now among the largest providers of these services. It employs more than 300 expert analysts and consultants to create data-driven intelligence products and advisory services for product managers, corporate strategists, channel chiefs and the C-suite, challenging market strategies, sharpening product roadmaps and accelerating time to market and revenue.

Through the Omdia brand, which now incorporates the formerly separate specialist brands Canalys, Wards Intelligence and Enterprise Strategy Group, we provide research and intelligence services to technology providers based on expert analysis and data-driven intelligence and reports. These products or businesses and their portfolio of digital media brands inform, educate and influence tech buyers, creating engaged and specialist audiences.

Targeted access to these specialist audiences is provided through a growing range of data-driven digital products and services that are designed to deliver highly qualified leads, demand generation and buyer intent to technology vendors, connecting them with the right buyers at the right time to maximize return on investment and accelerate growth.
Omdia by Informa TechTarget Industry Dive Informa TechTarget Information Week NetLine Light Reading

Informa TechTarget sits at the intersection of tech and B2B marketing, each dynamic innovative markets in their own right, with what management believes are compelling structural growth drivers. This provides a strong underpin to the long-term growth ambitions of Informa TechTarget.

Technology transcends all aspects of daily life and work. Enterprise technology, incorporating software and hardware systems used by large organizations for anything from customer relationship management to networking and cyber security, is central to operating effectively and efficiently. The pace of innovation and change is rapid, creating a constant cycle of investment to enhance, upgrade and replace technology.

For Informa TechTarget, investment in innovation and growth in R&D budgets provide a leading indicator of demand for its products and services. This growth in technology-related R&D is driving a new wave of investment and innovation, enhancing existing products and inspiring the next generation of products and services.

Over time, the scale of technology purchasing, particularly enterprise technology, has grown in size, resulting in B2B buying behavior becoming more complex. This complexity has led to longer sales cycles as more research is undertaken on purchasing technology products and platforms.

Typically, large technology decisions will involve a number of people across an organization from technology professionals to CIOs, CFOs and often CEOs. This research takes many forms, with an increasing amount conducted online, including by reading specialist content, reviews, information, product profiles and bespoke research, as well as through webinars and online discussions.

The majority of the B2B buyer journey is now completed before a buyer might contact the sales team of a vendor. For technology vendors, online presence and digital brand visibility are therefore critical, leading to more companies focusing their
spend on branded content services, thought leadership and whitepaper distribution, digital event participation and advertising on the most relevant platforms and media.

Management believes Informa TechTarget is at the center of this B2B buyer behavior, delivering highly relevant content and research to technology buyers that informs, educates and influences them along the different stages of their buyer journey.

paragraphs: TechTarget, Inc. ("Informa TechTarget", the "Company", "we", "us" or "our") 為一間領先的企業對企業 ("B2B") 成長加速器， globally informing and influencing 技術買家與賣家。
目前，我們處於科技與 B2B 廣告行銷的交會點，預估每年價值約 20 十億美元，擁有約 45,000 個潛在客戶。我們競爭的市場包括 Intelligence & Advisory、Brand & Content，以及 Demand & Intent。
我們在受許可的 B2B 第一方資料方面擁有強大的規模，並擁有獨特的端到端資料驅動解決方案，服務 B2B 產品生命週期的全過程，從 R&D 到回報率 ("ROI")：從策略、訊息與內容開發，到市場內激活，透過品牌、需求產生、購買意圖資料與銷售支援。我們越來越利用 AI 來強化我們對技術買家與賣家的差異化優勢，包括透過 AI 搜索頻道增加觀眾推薦。
對於我們所稱的觀眾（技術買家與企業專業人士），我們的策略是提供值得信賴、獨立的研究、原始資料、分析與高品質的編輯內容，這些內容能獨特地資訊並有潛力影響技術買家。我們相信我們在實現此策略上處於優勢位置。
對於我們所稱的客戶（技術賣家），我們的策略是提供由專家領導、資料驅動、數位化啟動的產品，協助這些客戶識別並影響技術買家，透過產品旅程的全過程，並基於此價值主張，我們希望成為許多技術產業最大、最成功、最快、最創新玩家的戰略夥伴，縮短這些客戶的上市時間與，關鍵地，收入時間。我們有成為領先 B2B 成長加速器的雄心。
我們在執行這些策略時，專注於四個核心成長驅動力：
1. 企業 IT 市場加速：企業 IT 市場預計在美國未來五年將以 7.1% 的複合年成長率成長，這是由緩和的通貨膨脹、改善的國內生產總值趨勢以及研發投資與創新加速成長所驅動，這背後是 AI 應用的快速擴張。
2. 國際擴張：我們估計，位於美國以外的技術賣家代表我們所提供產品的全球市場機會約為 40%。我們相信我們在利用此市場機會上處於優勢位置，並有意這麼做。透過我們的 Specialist Tech Research 事業與一系列本地化專門內容網站，我們在英國、印度、西班牙、法國、中國、澳洲、新加坡、日本及其他國家擁有據點，中東地區正成為越來越重要的機會。
3. 行業科技市場成長：我們計畫擴充產品組合至鄰近、以科技驅動成長的市場，例如 AutoTech、GameTech、HealthTech 和 FinTech，部分透過利用我們與 Informa 簽訂的資料共享協議（"Data Sharing Agreement"），以涵蓋這些成長市場的廣泛 B2B 資料集。

4. 新產品與平台開發：我們意圖利用我們擴充的規模、觸及範圍與人才，加速平台升級與新產品發佈，以提供更豐富的資料驅動洞察與更深的市場接觸。我們計畫開發的新產品包括以觀眾為導向的服務，例如新的內容網站、電子報與研究，這些服務旨在擴充與豐富 B2B 觀眾，以及用以加速客戶上市時程與獲利的產品與服務，包括 Intelligence & Advisory、Brand & Content 和 Intent & Demand。於 2025 年底，我們推出了 Informa TechTarget Portal，這是一個整合我們全部解決方案組合的統一平台，用以提供更有效的客戶銷售與行銷接觸。此新平台意圖顯著提升並取代 Priority Engine 的前身。
除了追求這些內生性成長機會，我們認為我們處於有利位置，可以透過機械性取得補充性業務，來擴充我們的業務與市場存在，這些業務可增加額外的資料、觀眾、內容與/或新的能力，進一步區隔我們的產品組合。
Informa TechTarget 將其部分產品以訂閱方式提供給客戶，包括預付年度合約（具有強勁現金特性）及其他受客戶終止權制約的合約。
我們預期將成長我們的訂閱與長期合約收入，使我們能與客戶進行更長時間的合作，並提供更大的持續性收入基礎。
我們處於科技與B2B行銷的交會點，每個市場各自為一動態且創新領域，且各自擁有強勁的結構性成長動力。我們估計參與這些相互關聯市場的參與者，每年自這些市場所產生的營業收入約為20 十億美元。我們認為這些市場的強勢與成長潛力，代表對我們而言是一個穩健且持續成長的市場機會。

Informa TechTarget協助科技公司透過第一方B2B資料、市場洞察及市場接觸來加速成長。
經過一段擴張期後，Informa TechTarget的專門科技研究業務已成為這些服務的主要提供者之一。該業務僱用超過300位專家分析師與顧問，為產品經理、企業戰略人員、通路主管及高階管理階層創造資料驅動的智慧產品與諮詢服務，挑戰市場策略、精準產品路線圖並加速上市時間與營收。
透過Omdia品牌，該品牌現已整合原先分離的專門品牌Canalys、Wards Intelligence及Enterprise Strategy Group，我們為科技供應商提供基於專家分析與資料驅動智慧及報告的研究與智慧服務。這些產品或業務及其數位媒體品牌的組合，用以資訊、教育及影響科技買家，創造專門且投入的受眾羣。
透過日益成長的資料驅動數位產品與服務，可針對這些專門受眾羣提供精準接觸，這些產品與服務設計用以提供高品質潛在客戶、需求生成及買家意圖給科技供應商，使其能於正確時間與正確買家接觸，以最大化投資回報並加速成長。

Informa TechTarget處於科技與B2B行銷的交會點，這兩個市場各自皆為動態創新市場，管理階層認為有強勁的結構性成長動力。這為Informa TechTarget的長期成長目標提供了堅實基礎。
科技已滲透至日常生活的各個方面與工作之中。企業科技，包含大型機構用以處理從客戶關係管理到網路與網路安全等各項業務的軟體與硬體系統，是有效且高效運作的關鍵。創新與變革的速度極快，創造出持續投資以升級、更新與更換科技的循環。
對於 Informa TechTarget，對創新與成長的投資，透過研發預算的增加，提供其產品與服務需求的領先指標。這項與科技相關的研發成長，正驅動一場新的投資與創新浪潮，提升現有產品，並啟發下一代的產品與服務。
隨著時間推移，科技產品的採購規模，特別是企業科技產品，已逐漸擴大，導致 B2B 購買行為變得更加複雜。這種複雜性導致銷售週期變長，因為在採購科技產品與平台時，進行的研討工作也隨之增加。
通常，大型科技決策會涉及組織內多個部門的參與，從科技專業人員到 CIOs、CFOs，甚至常見於 CEO。這項研究以多種形式展現，且有越來越多的內容在網路上進行，包括閱讀專門內容、評論、資訊、產品簡介與定製研究，以及透過網路研討會與線上討論。
目前，大多數 B2B 購買旅程已在買家聯繫供應商銷售團隊之前完成。因此，對科技供應商而言，在線存在感與數位品牌能見度變得至關重要，導致更多公司將預算用於品牌內容服務、意見領導力與白皮書發佈、數位活動參與以及在最相關平台與媒體上的廣告。
管理階層認為 Informa TechTarget 站在這 B2B 購買行為的中心，為科技買家提供高度相關的內容與研究，使其在購買旅程的不同階段獲得資訊、教育與影響力。

我們的遺留業務整合工作可能面臨挑戰，可能使我們無法實現交易預期的所有效益。
Informa 可能從事與我們競爭的業務及其他活動。
若未能成功執行並運作我們與 Informa 之間的資料共享協議，可能影響交易預期的效益。
我們所從事的競爭領域發展迅速，使預測我們產品與服務的需求變得困難。
由於我們的大多數客戶屬於企業科技產業，因此我們的收入受到企業科技產業特徵的影響，這些特徵可能影響 B2B 科技公司的廣告支出。
我們未來的成長在很大程度上取決於資料驅動產品與服務銷售的持續增加。
我們的收入主要來自短期契約，這些契約可能不會續約。
因為我們在訂閱期間內確認訂閱收入，因此新銷售、續約及升級的走勢起伏不會立即反映在我們的營業成果中。
若我們無法提供能吸引並留住大量會員與使用者的內容與服務，可能影響我們吸引客戶的能力，進而對我們的收入產生不利影響。
我們的國際業務及其擴張面臨許多風險，這些風險可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
客戶在行銷與廣告支出上的競爭非常激烈，我們可能無法成功競爭，這可能會導致我們的市佔率、客戶數量及收入大幅下降。
我們可能面臨其他擁有技術與數據提供 B2B 市場洞察與市場准入的公司競爭，競爭產品與服務可能對客戶更具吸引力。
我們依賴關鍵合作對手支持我們的業務，並協助交付我們的部分產品，包括與我們不控制的第三方應用程式與系統整合。
我們可能無法以成功的速度進行創新，這可能會影響我們的營運成果。
我們可能無法持續建立品牌知名度，這可能會對我們的業務產生負面影響，並導致收入下降。
若我們無法留住關鍵人員，將會不利於我們執行商業策略的能力。
我們可能對智慧財產權的保護有限，他人可能侵權。
來自第三方基於我們網站上由我們及第三方所創造內容的聲請，可能導致高昂的訴訟費用、賠償金支付或需修改我們經營業務的方式。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的普通股涉及重大風險。您應謹慎考慮下列因素，並配合本年度報告中包含的所有其他資訊，包括於「管理層對財務狀況及營運結果之討論與分析」標題下以及合併財務報表及相關附註中所載資訊，再決定是否投資本公司普通股。我們在下文中所描述的任何風險因素，可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運結果造成不利影響。若其中一個或多個風險或不確定性發展為實際事件，本公司普通股市價可能會下跌，導致您損失全部或部分投資。本公司無法保證下列所討論的任何事件不會發生。請同時參閱本年度報告中「有關未來展望陳述之警示說明」部分以取得更多資訊。
本公司管理團隊將持續投入關注與資源，以整合先前作為獨立業務運作的業務作法與營運。我們在整合過程中可能遇到的潛在困難包括以下各項：
• 成功整合，或無法成功整合，本公司各項業務，包括其各自之營運、技術、產品與服務以及客戶契約，以達成預期之成本節省與營收協同效益，這可能會導致預期之結合效益無法在目前預期時間內或完全實現；
• 某些客戶決定不與本公司進行業務，或減少與本公司進行業務的金額，以降低對單一公司的依賴，導致銷售與客戶流失；
• 需要協調地理上分離的組織、系統與設施；
• 結合過程可能產生的潛在未知負債與未預見的增加費用、延誤或監管條件。
